title: Cobblemon WITH LYRICS
description: A simple Cobblemon and Create modpack with a variety of performance, QoL, worldgen, and aesthetic additions
body:
A simple Cobblemon and Create modpack with a variety of performance, QoL, worldgen, and aesthetic additions.

Notable mods include:
- Cobblemon
- Create
- Create: Cobblemon Manufactory
- Tom's Simple Storage
- Create: Let The Adventure Begin
- Farmer's Delight
- Serene Seasons
- Oh the Biomes We've Gone
- BetterNether
- BetterEnd

Doesn't actually have anything to do with brentalfloss
